model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts illustrating enterprise, employment, and turnover data for the industries of construction, trade, and services in 2021, with values presented as percentages of the total economy and absolute figures. The first chart, "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows that the construction sector (blue) accounts for 61% (19.0 million), trade (red) for 19% (5.9 million), other services (dark blue) for 12% (3.7 million), and industry (gold) for 8% (2.4 million). The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," indicates that other services (dark blue) employ 51% (80.2 million), construction (blue) 19% (29.5 million), trade (red) 9% (13.4 million), and industry (gold) 21% (33.0 million). The third chart, "TURNOVER," reveals that other services (dark blue) have 31% (9.9 trillion), trade (red) 31% (9.8 trillion), industry (gold) 33% (10.6 trillion), and construction (blue) 6% (1.9 trillion). A legend at the bottom identifies the color coding for each sector: industry (gold), construction (blue), trade (red), and other services (dark blue). The charts are sourced from Eurostat, based on NACE Rev. 2.
